deck: SAM.GOV REGISTRATION, SET-ASIDE TARGETING AND THREE-QUOTE MARKUP BIDS
PRIME LIABILITY, SUBCONTRACTING LIMITS AND THE CASH FLOAT TO GET PAID
site_ui.lead: Practitioners from boosters to former contracting officers show how to register free through Login.gov and SAM.gov, filter for small business set-asides, pull three vendor quotes, add a 20% to 100% markup, and win as a prime that carries full performance liability without crossing the 100% pass-through line.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies on government contract brokering, from registration and set-aside targeting to pricing, subcontracting limits, DIBBS parts brokering and getting paid. Every claim, metric, pro-tip and quote carries timestamped inline attribution to the practitioner and video it came from.
chapters: The Middleman Model and Its Legal Line
Micro-Purchases, Simplified Acquisitions and Commercial Items
Case Studies: From First Win to Nine Figures

Funding the Contract and Getting Paid
flow: Sign in through Login.gov, validate the entity in SAM.gov for a 12-character UEI, and let DLA assign the free five-character CAGE code; renew every 365 days.
Filter SAM.gov for small business set-asides, open every attachment, and check whether clause 52.219-14 is checked before planning to subcontract.
Pull three vendor quotes from the big players before opening a Word document, and line up a backup sub at the same price.
Pull the prior contract amount from the point of contact, USA Spending or FPDS, then add a 20% to 100% markup.
Confirm the vendor accepts pay-after-paid with a stop-work clause, and document management with an org chart, defined roles and Gantt charts.
Prove you can carry sub payroll for 60 to 90 days through a line of credit or cash reserve, because agencies can pay months late.
